definitions.explanation: any material that has been printed, including books, flyers, pamphlets, and postal printed matter

examples.japanese: {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}れる→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Printed matter can be sent at a cheaper postal rate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A large amount of printed material was distributed.

examples.japanese: ⟦デジタル{化|か}→デジタル化：08829_dejitaruka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なくならない。
examples.english: Even as digitalization progresses, the demand for printed materials will not completely disappear.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧ (printing) and ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing/object). A general term for anything that has been printed. In postal contexts, {印刷物|いんさつぶつ} is a specific mail category with lower rates than regular letters, similar to "printed matter" classification in international mail.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to distribute printed materials
- {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧: printed matter mail
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{印刷物|いんさつぶつ}: large quantity of printed matter
- {印刷物|いんさつぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制作|せいさく}→制作：04320_seisaku⟧: production of printed materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刊行物|かんこうぶつ}→刊行物：24580_kankoubutsu⟧: publication — formally published works like books and journals
- ⟦{出版物|しゅっぱんぶつ}→出版物：15497_shuppanbutsu⟧: published material — commercially published works
- ⟦{配布物|はいふぶつ}→配布物：18105_haifubutsu⟧: handouts, distributed materials — items given out, whether printed or not
